attributes.name: Buckler Gun
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d8 and add the Piercing and Ranged traits; this counts as playing a weapon instead of an armor.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 2. If proficient with light armors, you may play another armor on this check.

corrections.corrected_text: On the armor Buckler Gun, change "add the Ranged trait" to "add the Piercing and Ranged traits".
corrections.issue: Should the Buckler Gun add the Piercing trait to the check?
